侍从将你放在石头地板上一圈信符的中央。他从墙上取出一把像剑一样长的手术刀。

“这会有一点疼，”他说，“然后你会失去对疼痛的理解。” 

信符像星星一样闪耀。手术刀滑入你的身体，就在锁骨上方，细腻和精确地勾勒出你身体的轮廓。只流了一点血。你的皮肤被削去，就像剥皮的水果一样。

随后，信符的火焰吞噬了你。世界消失了。

alternative.original:
The Attendant lays you on the bare stone floor, at the centre of a circle of engraved Correspondence symbols. He takes from the wall a scalpel as long as a sword.

"This will hurt for a moment," he says. "Then you will lose your comprehension of pain."

Symbols flare like stars. The scalpel slides into you, just above the collarbone, and traces your outline with delicacy and precision. There is only a little blood. Your skin comes away in rinds, like shucked fruit.

The blaze of Correspondence devours you. The world falls away.

conflicts.original:
This clock must have been designed by a madman. Though the gears seem to know what they're doing, you can make no sense out of it whatsoever. Passers-by outside wonder where the thirteenth BONG! came from. 

Fortunately, you are not the only Horologist here. A skilled apprentice present on unrelated reasons soon intervenes, promising to fix things on your behalf if you'll just put away your tools and go anywhere else for a few hours. In exchange for your fee, obviously.

selected.original:

Fortunately, you are not the only Horologist here. A skilled apprentice present on unrelated reasons soon intervenes, promising to fix things on your behalf if you'll just put away your tools and go anywhere else for a few hours. In exchange for your fee, obviously.

conflicts.original: You retreat to a comfortable distance. After some time, the station's engineers extract the unexploded shell and remove it for detonation. Your crew exhale, as one.

conflicts.original:
Your locomotive is playing host to the Guests: a species of arm-length, eel-like slug. Left unchecked, they will engulf the whole engine.

Fortunately, the Guests are sufficiently despised that associations of volunteers have formed at major ports to evict them from visiting locomotives. 

There is no charge – the Guests are a menace to shipping.

selected.original:
Your locomotive is playing host to the Guests: a species of arm-length, eel-like slug. Left unchecked, they will engulf the whole engine.

Fortunately, the Guests are sufficiently despised that associations of volunteers have formed at major ports to evict them from visiting locomotives. 

There is no charge – the Guests are a menace to shipping.
selected.translation:
你的机车正接待着寄客虫：它们是一种手臂般长，形似鳗鱼的蛞蝓状生物。如果放任不管，它们会占据整辆机车。

所幸，寄客虫是如此惹人厌恶，以至于每个枢纽车站都有志愿者组织起来，为来访的机车提供清理服务。

他们分文不取——寄客虫对车运业也是个威胁。

幸好，寄客虫是如此惹人厌恶，以至于每个枢纽港口都有志愿者组织起来，为来访的机车提供清理服务。

不收费——寄客虫对航运业也是个威胁。

conflicts.original:
Once the volunteers have stripped your engine bare and piled its contents on the platform, the band strikes up in your galley. Soon, the Guests begin to squirm, frantically, from your engine. You can't blame them.

As each emerges it is scooped up with a shovel and popped into a steel bucket, which is then rolled away to destinations unknown.

selected.original:
Once the volunteers have stripped your engine bare and piled its contents on the platform, the band strikes up in your galley. Soon, the Guests begin to squirm, frantically, from your engine. You can't blame them.

As each emerges it is scooped up with a shovel and popped into a steel bucket, which is then rolled away to destinations unknown.
selected.translation:
等志愿者们把机车内部扫荡一空，将所有东西堆上站台，乐队便在你的厨房室内开始演奏。没用多久，寄客虫们就疯狂地扭动着从机车里爬出。这也怪不了它们。

每只爬出的虫子都被铲进铁桶，桶子则被滚到未知的去处。

他们分文不取——寄客虫对车运业也是个威胁。

alternative.original:
Your locomotive is playing host to the Guests: a species of arm-length, eel-like slug. Left unchecked, they will engulf the whole engine.

Fortunately, the Guests are sufficiently despised that associations of volunteers have formed at major ports to evict them from visiting locomotives. 

There is no charge – the Guests are a menace to shipping.
alternative.translation:
你的机车被寄客虫寄生了：它们是一种手臂般长，形似鳗鱼的蛞蝓。如果放任不管，它们会占据整辆机车。

幸好，寄客虫是如此惹人厌恶，以至于每个枢纽港口都有志愿者组织起来，为来访的机车提供清理服务。

不收费——寄客虫对航运业也是个威胁。

conflicts.original:
Once the volunteers have stripped your engine bare and piled its contents on the platform, the band strikes up in your galley. Soon, the Guests begin to squirm, frantically, from your engine. You can't blame them.

As each emerges it is scooped up with a shovel and popped into a steel bucket, which is then rolled away to destinations unknown.

selected.original:
Once the volunteers have stripped your engine bare and piled its contents on the platform, the band strikes up in your galley. Soon, the Guests begin to squirm, frantically, from your engine. You can't blame them.

As each emerges it is scooped up with a shovel and popped into a steel bucket, which is then rolled away to destinations unknown.
selected.translation:
等志愿者们把机车内部扫荡一空，将所有东西堆上站台，乐队便在你的厨房室内开始演奏。没用多久，寄客虫们就疯狂地扭动着从机车里爬出。这也怪不了它们。

每只爬出的虫子都被铲进铁桶，桶子则被滚到未知的去处。

conflicts.original:
With the aid of a pair of stokers, you erect a simple snare, before retreating to watch from a hiding place.

The bee, when it appears, is not convinced. Its antenna twitch, its stinger emerges. 

Before you've time to flee, the bee is bearing down upon you. You're able to shelter amidst a thicket of young flower, but the stokers are not so lucky.  Your records will be simple. Cause of Death: Bee. It's not so uncommon in the Reach.

selected.original:

selected.translation:
在一对司炉工的帮助下，你竖起一个简单的陷阱，然后撤退到一个隐蔽的地方观察。

蜜蜂出现时有些警惕。它的触须抽动，它的毒刺露出。

你还没来得及逃跑，蜜蜂就向你袭来了。你可以躲在一丛年轻的花朵中，但司炉工就没那么幸运了。你的记录会很简单。死因：蜜蜂。这在外野并不罕见。

selected.translation: 在你之前的拾荒者干得不错。你在工厂里什么也找不到，只剩下回荡着脚步声的走廊、透风的车间和蜘蛛网。

alternative.original: The scavengers that preceded you have done their work well. You find nothing in the factory but echoing corridors, draughty workshops, and cobwebs.

conflicts.original: Occasionally, you could take it out and contemplate your mortality. It also makes an excellent conversation starter. Poets in particular are terribly impressed.

selected.original: Occasionally, you could take it out and contemplate your mortality. It also makes an excellent conversation starter. Poets in particular are terribly impressed.
selected.translation: 偶尔，你可以把它拿出来，思考你的死亡。它也会是一个很好的谈话开端。尤其是对诗人来说，他们对它印象深刻。

conflicts.original: 'It is good to love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is well done.' (You can acquire these from Sweet Jane or the Toll-Tower.)

selected.original: 'It is good to love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is well done.' (You can acquire these from Sweet Jane or the Toll-Tower.)
selected.translation: ‘爱得很多是好的，因为真正的力量就在这里，凡是爱的多的人，就会有那么大的作为，能有那么大的成就，在爱中做的事就是好的。’(你可以从蜜糖阿简或渡灵塔获得此物。）

alternative.original: 'It is good to love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is well done.' (You can acquire these from Sweet Jane or the Toll-Tower.)
alternative.translation: “爱得很多是好的，因为真正的力量就在这里，凡是爱的多的人，就会有那么大的作为，能有那么大的成就，在爱中做的事就是好的。”(你可以从蜜糖阿简或渡灵塔获得这些东西）。

conflicts.original: For tea-drinkers it's a sweetener; for poets an inebriant. For singers it's an enhancement, widening the vocal range by a valuable semi-tone or two.

selected.original: For tea-drinkers it's a sweetener; for poets an inebriant. For singers it's an enhancement, widening the vocal range by a valuable semi-tone or two.
selected.translation: 它是茶客的甘饴，诗人的佳酿，歌唱家的灵药，可以让音域拓宽一两个宝贵的半音。

alternative.original: For tea-drinkers it's a sweetener; for poets an inebriant. For singers it's an enhancement, widening the vocal range by a valuable semi-tone or two.
alternative.translation: 对饮茶者来说，它是一种甜味剂；对诗人来说，它像酒精一样让人沉醉。对歌唱家来说，它是一种增强，可以将音域拓宽一两个宝贵的半音。

conflicts.original: Fine London china; porcelain plates bearing the Empress' face; cups and saucers, traced with roses.

selected.original: Fine London china; porcelain plates bearing the Empress' face; cups and saucers, traced with roses.
selected.translation: 精美的伦敦瓷器；印有女王面容的瓷盘；描有玫瑰花纹的杯碟。

alternative.original: Fine London china; porcelain plates bearing the Empress' face; cups and saucers, traced with roses.
alternative.translation: 精美的伦敦瓷器；印有皇后面容的瓷盘；描有玫瑰花纹的杯碟。

conflicts.original: It has been thoroughly censored. Nothing here is likely to startle your maiden aunt. Or make her cackle.

selected.original: It has been thoroughly censored. Nothing here is likely to startle your maiden aunt. Or make her cackle.
selected.translation: 已经过仔细删减的作品。里面的内容，恐怕既吓不着，也逗不乐你那老处女姨妈。

alternative.original: It has been thoroughly censored. Nothing here is likely to startle your maiden aunt. Or make her cackle.
alternative.translation: 它已被仔细地删减过，恐怕里面的任何内容都不可能吓到或逗乐你那纯洁得跟白纸似的姨妈了。

conflicts.original: From which mighty trunks may grow. Or any number of other things. The flora of the High Wilderness is erratic.

selected.original: From which mighty trunks may grow. Or any number of other things. The flora of the High Wilderness is erratic.
selected.translation: 从中可以长出强健的树干，或任何数量的其他东西。天野的植物极不稳定。

alternative.original: From which mighty trunks may grow. Or any number of other things. The flora of the High Wilderness is erratic.
alternative.translation: 从中可以长出强健的树干。或任何数量的其他东西。天野的植物极不稳定。

conflicts.original: This midnight-hued fabric grows heavy with devoured light. The perfect adornment for ostentatious grief and clandestine activity.

selected.translation: 这种午夜色的织物因吞噬了光线而变得沉重。作为炫耀悲伤和秘密活动的完美装饰品最合适不过了。

conflicts.original: What censored sentiments are held within its pages? Are they seditious? Revolutionary? Lascivious? The Ministry of Public Decency would be horrified.

selected.original: What censored sentiments are held within its pages? Are they seditious? Revolutionary? Lascivious? The Ministry of Public Decency would be horrified.
selected.translation: 在它的字里行间中隐藏着何种受到审查的情感？它们有煽动性吗？革命性？还是会挑动情欲？公德部会被它吓坏的。

alternative.original: What censored sentiments are held within its pages? Are they seditious? Revolutionary? Lascivious? The Ministry of Public Decency would be horrified.
alternative.translation: 它的书页中藏着什么会被审查的情绪？它们有煽动性吗？革命性？淫荡内容？公德部会被吓坏的。

conflicts.original: One of Fallen London's earliest and most persistent sins. To taste red honey is to walk the corridors of another's heart. None of their secrets will be safe from you.

selected.original: One of Fallen London's earliest and most persistent sins. To taste red honey is to walk the corridors of another's heart. None of their secrets will be safe from you.
selected.translation: 沦敦最古老也最悠久的罪孽之一。品尝红蜂蜜就如同在他人心中的走廊里漫步。他们的秘密在你面前无所遁形。

alternative.original: One of Fallen London's earliest and most persistent sins. To taste red honey is to walk the corridors of another's heart. None of their secrets will be safe from you.
alternative.translation: 堕落的伦敦最早和最持久的罪过之一。尝到红色的蜂蜜就是走在另一个人的心脏走廊里。他们的秘密在你面前都不会是安全的。
